decel.reason: TTM revenue growth slowed from about 8% to about 4%, a four point deceleration in one year.

pricing.reason: The 10-Q says prices were cut 3% in the quarter, which is pricing pressure.

margin_pressure.reason: Operating margin is still rising to its 20% peak, so there is no cost pressure showing yet.

tailwind.reason: Nothing in the filings points to a temporary tailwind that will fade.

share_loss.reason: The filings name no competitor taking share in this fixture company.

incr_margin.reason: Margin sits at its ten-year peak, so the only way from here is down.

capex.reason: Capex runs at about 1.8 times D&A, a step-up just to keep the business where it is.

leaky.reason: Acquisitions are only about a tenth of operating cash flow over five years, not a leaky bucket.

fcf.reason: Under half of adjusted net income turned into free cash flow over five years.

hope.reason: No new product or plan is priced into this fixture stock as far as the documents show.

overhang.reason: No regulatory or technology overhang is discussed in the fixture documents.

miss.reason: There is not enough intra-quarter information to call the next print a miss.

revisions.reason: The Street cut its FY 2027 EPS mean from 2.30 to 2.20 between snapshots.

vs_dcf.reason: The price of about 51 dollars sits above the 42 dollar DCF base value.

vs_peers.reason: The P/E gap to core peers is at its 75th percentile over five years.

vs_history.reason: The trailing P/E sits at its 85th percentile over five years of history.

vs_algo.reason: If the P/E only rolls forward the stock returns about five percent, below the hurdle.

reward_eps.reason: Cut next year's EPS by about a third as the 3% price cuts the 10-Q describes flow through.

reward_pe.reason: The five-year median P/E: where the stock trades once the premium fades.

dream_eps.reason: A dream case where price cuts stop and margins expand two more points over a year.

dream_pe.reason: The five-year peak P/E, what a semi-rational bull would pay.

takeout_premium.reason: Peers sold at a 35% premium, so that is the takeout risk case.

type.reason: A slowing grower at a rich multiple that returns less than the hurdle if nothing changes.

bucket.reason: Revenue growth has halved in two years and estimates are coming down.

catalyst.text: No dated catalyst in the next two prints; the slowdown is gradual.
catalyst.reason: Nothing in the documents dates a guide cut or event in the next six months.

takeout_prone.reason: Peers have been bought at a 35% premium, so a bid is a real risk to size for.

smoke_checked: Read the 10-Q for auditor, CFO and CAO changes and changes in the metrics the company discloses.

verdict.reason: The rule's call: the IRR sits below the hurdle and valuation passes.

why: A slowing grower at a peak margin and a rich multiple: a filler short, not an alpha short, with no catalyst.
